thread:
maria-support: FYI customer acme-inc (INC-5642) hitting sustained 503s. They’re on Dedicated pool 'acme-prod-gpu' and it never scales >2 replicas even under load. Repro steps and logs pasted below. @noah-oncall can you triage?

ryan-sre: On it. quick question — is this HPA or cluster-autoscaler behavior?

alex-platform: Likely both. Can you paste `kubectl get hpa` and any autoscaler events?

maria-support: Paste:```
kubectl get hpa -n acme
NAME            REFERENCE                  TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS   AGE
inference-hpa   Deployment/inference-svc  450%/80%     2        10         2       3h

kubectl describe hpa inference-hpa -n acme | grep -A3 -i events
Events:
  Type    Reason         Age    From                           Message
  ----    ------         ---    ----                           -------
  Normal  SuccessfulRescale  2h  horizontal-pod-autoscaler     New size: 8
  Warning  ScalingLimited   1h   cluster-autoscaler           Scale up limited by max nodes or insufficient capacity
```

maria-support: Also autoscaler logs (filtered):```
I0308 15:22:11 cluster-autoscaler.go:123] pod pending: inference-svc-xyz queue length high
I0308 15:22:12 scale_up.go:98] attempted scale up: nodesBefore=4 nodesAfter=4 err=NoCapacity: could not find available instance type
I0308 15:23:05 scale_up.go:150] scalingLimited=true reason=MaxNodeGroupSizeReached
```

noah-oncall: Checking cloud console and ASG sizes now. If nodegroup is at max we’ll see `DesiredCapacity == MaxSize` on the autoscaling group.

infra-bot: AutoscalerEvent: cluster=redwood-prod region=us-west-2 nodegroup=gpu-pool-1 scale_up_delay_seconds=600 last_scale_time=1769754000 scalingLimited=true

alex-platform: I see a recent config patch last week setting `--scale-up-delay=600s` for gpu nodegroups to dampen noisy spikes. That plus using p4d instance types (longer spin up) explains the slow reaction.

ryan-sre: Two things: 1) the HPA requested 8 but cluster could only provide 2 due to nodegroup caps/capacity -> app saw 503s. 2) minReplicas=2 means cold starts are expensive; for this workload we need a higher floor.

maria-support: Customer timeline: spike at 15:20, errors from 15:21-15:40, impacted webhooks + sync jobs. They attached traces showing p95 token latency jumped 3x.

alex-platform: Mitigation plan (short): bump minReplicas from 2 -> 4 for acme-prod-gpu, and temporarily increase nodegroup max size by +2 to allow scale. Lower the `--scale-up-delay` to 60s for this nodegroup as an emergency.

noah-oncall: Before making infra changes we need to validate quota and spare capacity: running: `aws ec2 describe-instance-type-offerings --filters ...` and `aws autoscaling describe-auto-scaling-groups --auto-scaling-group-names gpu-pool-1`

ryan-sre: I'll prepare a quick k8s patch for the HPA and a kube patch to taint/label if we want dedicated placement. Patch command:```
kubectl patch hpa inference-hpa -n acme -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":4}}'
```

maria-support: Repro steps I used so we can validate after patch: 1) hit /generate with 200 concurrent requests over 2m 2) watch `kubectl get hpa` and cluster-autoscaler logs 3) confirm `Desired:8 Current:4` within 3m

alex-platform: Long-term: add a prewarm pool or adjust model-serving startup hook to eager-initialize weights/KV cache to avoid long tails. Also add autoscaler override per-customer to avoid global dampening flags applying to critical customers.

noah-oncall: Quick actions taken: increased ASG max from 4->6, applied HPA minReplicas=4. Lowered scale-up-delay to 60s on staging then to prod after smoke.

infra-bot: DeployEvent: autoscaler-config updated (gpu-pool-1): `--scale-up-delay=60s` by ryan-sre at 1769754700

ryan-sre: Monitoring now. If we see churn or noisy neighbor again we'll revert and put a per-tenant override.

maria-support: Updated customer: told them we bumped min replicas to 4 and increased pool capacity temporarily. They accepted a 2-hour trial and will monitor. Ticket INC-5642 note attached.

simon-customer-success: Thanks team — please add a short postmortem to the ticket and recommend per-customer capacity SLA for Dedicated customers.

ryan-sre: Action items: 1) PR to make per-nodegroup scale-up-delay configurable by tenant (ryan) 2) runbook update for Dedicated coldstart incidents (noah) 3) prewarm/predictive cache experiment (alex) 4) update customer ticket and follow up in 2h (maria)

maria-support: Closing loop for now. Will re-open if metrics don’t return to normal. :thumbsup:
